Meet the artist

Nancy L White

A self-taught mixed-media abstract artist based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Over the past decade Nancy has pushed her practice into new techniques and materials, with one goal: work that evokes emotion and gives every owner a piece no one else has.

Surfaces

Canvas, tile, wood, glass and resin

Techniques

Fluid acrylics, stains, water, torches, airflow and gravity

Her work has been commissioned, shown at local art shows and collected privately.
